pro_course_detail.title: ★ Job Interview Coaching for Brazilians ★
pro_course_detail.description:
You only get one chance to make a first impression! 
Make your CV stand out from the crowd, “wow” the recruiters by your English skills and boost your career!

Have you applied to many jobs but aren’t getting interviews? 
Are you going on interviews but don’t receive job offers?  

Don’t worry! I’m here to help you succeed in your job hunting and interview! 
Sign up to this 5-hour course specially designed for Brazilians who are looking for better job opportunities! 

✓ Help with your CV
✓ Mock interview questions: what to say and how to say it better. 
✓ All our notes in a Google document, with useful links and phrases.
✓ Ted Talk videos about business - we will discuss the talk while reviewing and incorporating the new vocabulary.
  
FIRST LESSON:

1) I will read over your CV and provide recommendations for suggestions of phrases and vocabulary. 
2) You will talk about the work that you do and/or you are looking for so that I can get to know you and construct our lessons to give you exactly what you need. 
3) We will draw up a set of objectives for us to work towards over the coming days and weeks. 

Then, I will send an Interview Preparation document and you’ll have a lot of interview practice with me! You will learn how to speak clearly and confidently about yourself, your accomplishments and career goals and how to talk about your weaknesses in a compelling way.
 
 We also could work on: 
- Improving your conversational and written English. For example, we may construct a mock email conversation in which you will need to argue a point.
- Improving presentation skills. I may ask you to research a rival company and give me a presentation on how your company could compete with them, for example. 
- Practicing for real-life by role-playing office scenarios & meetings, with agendas, debates & business language.
